d.ko: Rewrite fate with every strike. Face gods, mythic heroes, and legendary beasts in this souls-like Action RPG set in ancient Greece. Master brutal combat, unlock divine skills, and shape Achilles into the warrior only you can become.
d.en: Rewrite fate with every strike. Face gods, mythic heroes, and legendary beasts in this souls-like Action RPG set in ancient Greece. Master brutal combat, unlock divine skills, and shape Achilles into the warrior only you can become.
d.zh: 准备好迎接一款非同寻常的动作 RPG 游戏，体验灵魂般的激烈战斗。掌握格挡和闪避技巧，探索充满无数挑战的广阔开放世界。经历挫折后变得更加强大，增强属性，获得技能，挥舞烈剑或毒矛。准备好开始难忘的冒险了吗？
